letterContent: I am so truly sorry for upsetting you.
Looking through our memories together, all I could think about is how much your smile means to me.
Can we hug it out and start over? I promise to listen more and hold you tighter.

scratchCard.title: Peel to heal my heart 🩹
scratchCard.hiddenText: Redeemable: 1x Dinner of your choice + Unlimited Hugs! 🍦

runawayQuestion.question: Are you still super mad at me?
runawayQuestion.successMessage: Yay! Thank you for forgiving me! ❤
